messages:
hana-finance: FYI reconciliation flagged a weird one: some customers in APAC received invoices where the discount line and a VAT line were swapped, producing negative VAT totals. example attached.

mike-eng: can you share an invoice id?

hana-finance: INV-2024-7010 / cust-apac-32. Customer saw VAT=-$420 and discount +$420 on one pdf, another pdf shows normal VAT +420 and discount -420. totals differ and some customers paid the wrong amount.

render-bot: finalize_job:apac_202406 completed 2512345600 status=SUCCESS invoices_finalized=9800 anomalies_detected=11

ops-sre: looks like a renderer mapping bug: when line_items array and tax_lines array are interleaved by index during a streaming render, an off-by-one from a recent perf patch can associate tax amount with previous discount line. duplicates come from retry path where different worker snapshots of line order produced different PDF outputs.

mike-eng: reproducer snippet: 
```
# pseudo
for i, line in enumerate(line_items):
  writer.write(line)
  writer.write(tax_lines[i])  # assumption: same length -> fails if lengths mismatch
```

support-lead: ~18 tickets so far. several customers already paid the higher total. we need to pause payout for impacted batch and prepare correction emails.

hana-finance: please pause outbound invoice emails for apac_202406 batch. finance will prepare credit memos and refunds for overcharges.

mike-eng: mitigation: 1) patch renderer to explicitly map tax to line via canonical_line_id instead of index, 2) add a render-sanity check that ensures tax sum == expected_tax_total before finalizing PDF, 3) add idempotency lock to prevent duplicate finalizes. hotfix queued.

ops-sre: invalidating render cache and queuing re-finalize for affected invoices.

billing-bot: re_finalize queued by mike-eng at 2512345800

mike-eng: hotfix deployed 2512345860. re-finalize completed 2512345900: duplicates_voided=11 corrections_applied=11 credits_issued=9 refunds_initiated=2

support-lead: sending prioritized outreach to customers who paid. draft comms: "We identified rendering errors that affected tax presentation on some invoices. We have corrected your invoice and issued credits/refunds as needed." approved by finance.

hana-finance: adding follow-ups to postmortem: render mapping tests, add PDF diff smoke test in CI, and alert on invoice_tax_mismatch > 0. closing thread once postmortem doc linked. :thumbsup:
